root_idea.summary: The root centers on abundance together with gathering or accumulation: what is plentiful, collected, full, or assembled. A separate lexical branch denotes lacking a weapon or projecting feature.
root_idea.development: From the idea of things collecting and becoming abundant arise fullness, gathered water, gathered strength and rest, masses of hair or vegetation, and assembled groups. The sources also preserve a distinct branch for being without a spear or horn, extended to things without projecting features.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is the adjective جَمّ, which is a suitable normalized public headword.

senses.definition: Very much, abundant, or immense; great in quantity or degree.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quran 89:20, it describes the great intensity or abundance of love for wealth in the construction حُبًّا جَمًّا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become abundant or numerous; of water, to collect, return, and become plentiful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of water, people, and other things that increase or collect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become full, or to fill a measure to its capacity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a measure that becomes full and of causing a measure to be filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to abstain from covering so that its seminal fluid collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine usage concerning sexual covering and accumulated seminal fluid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recover from fatigue and regain strength; to rest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a horse, but also of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bone, to have or become covered with much flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the fleshiness or abundance of flesh on a bone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become high or rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source gives this as a separate lexical use, possibly of water in a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or increase in pace or speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the manner of an individual's going or movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw near or come to pass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event, a person's arrival, separation from another, or an object of want.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a plant, to reach the stage at which it has a tuft, head, or flower-bud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of specified grasses and plants attaining a developed tuft or bud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a ram, sheep, or goat, to be hornless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave water in a well so that it collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively of leaving a well or its water for accumulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a measure so that it is full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the passive or intransitive description of a measure being filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land or herbage, to become abundant or develop into mature, dense growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of vegetation becoming like a جَمِيم or a full tuft of growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or arrange a جُمَّة, a mass or lock of head hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of styling the hair into the form called جُمَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a horse unridden so that it recovers from fatigue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative/passive construction concerns giving the horse a period of rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone or something rest or relief; to let land lie fallow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of resting a person, relieving the heart, or giving cultivated land rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone the collected supply of water from a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the water that has accumulated after drawing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a grapevine, to have its branches above ground cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized horticultural passive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gather or collect around someone, especially while standing in his presence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the reported expression for people assembling closely around a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collected supply of water remaining after water has been drawn from a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source illustrates the supply as subsequently being drunk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak indistinctly or unclearly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source distinguishes the usage from speech caused by physical incapacity in one reported explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal speech or a matter in one's breast and not reveal it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively with a thing concealed inwardly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To destroy or kill another person or others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate reported lexical use of the Form R.Q. verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back from an affair and not dare to undertake it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiomatic construction with عَنِ الأَمْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The greater or main portion of midday, especially the summer midday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal nominal use distinct from the adjective meaning abundant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The collected water of a well, or the place in which that water collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source distinguishes the collected water from the place of collection, while recording both under this lexical family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large company or group of people assembled together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for people coming together in great numbers or as a collective body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People of the lowest, basest, or meanest sort.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The measuring of a vessel up to the head or top of the measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical measurement expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part or place of a ship in which leaking water collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nautical technical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company that comes to demand bloodwit, an obligation, peace, or another requested matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional social and legal usage; the group is defined by its collective purpose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The collective mass of head hair, especially abundant hair hanging toward or beyond the ears and shoulders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record varying traditional limits for the length of a جُمَّة; the central meaning is a substantial gathered mass of head hair. The related adjective may describe a person having such long or abundant hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tuft or flower-bud of a plant from which the flower emerges.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized plant usage connected with the idea of a gathered tuft.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possibly the husk or outer covering of a walnut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported tentatively in a tropical expression; the interpretation is not presented as certain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or period of rest, especially the rest of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for recovery or respite after exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seminal fluid of a horse collected after it has rested from covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity placed in a vessel or measure, especially what rises above its head after filling; also a full bowlful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used chiefly of flour and similar substances, with related usage for a bowlful of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well possessing much or abundant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun or adjective applied to a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that continues to run repeatedly or goes much after each run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to either a male or female horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state of being satiated or satisfied with food or drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal state of full satisfaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bean or beans, synonymous with باقِلَّى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant or food term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The skull or bones of the head; by extension, a head or a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anatomical sense concerns the bone enclosing the brain; the head/person sense is a metonymic use in taxation and similar expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden or glass bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate vessel sense of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure for corn, grain, or similar commodities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical measure sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief, leading tribal group, or powerful and eminent tribe that encompasses subordinate clans.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective use based on the head as the noblest or encompassing part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well dug in salty or saline ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place-name-like lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of sixty camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional counting term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The piece of wood at the head of a plough to which the ploughshare is attached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical agricultural term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Greater or greatest in quantity, number, or extent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective; the source also applies it to the greatest amount of revelation in a reported expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bone, having much flesh upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive bodily adjective distinct from the related Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hornless; figuratively, without a spear or other weapon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to rams, sheep, goats, and, figuratively, to people or horses lacking a spear in battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smooth, low, or without projecting or raised features.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to buildings or mosques without ornamental projections, flat roofs without parapets, and things or persons lacking elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anterior pudendum of a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical usage recorded as figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage connected in the source with the smooth or unprojecting sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A helmet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage attributed to its smoothness and coverage of the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The breast, bosom, or mind as the place where knowledge and concerns are gathered and retained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom describing breadth or constriction of mind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or thing in which resting normally takes place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun derived from the rest sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A boy whose head bears a mass of hair called a جُمَّة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participial adjective referring specifically to the boy's hairstyle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who arranges her hair into a جُمَّة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive feminine participle concerning the styling of the hair.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Tropical phrase is only referred to another article for explanation.
